visualStyle: Mid-to-late twentieth-century black-and-white 35mm press photograph texture, visible irregular organic film grain, candid tonal contrast, subtle printing imperfections, readable faces and subject, minimal scratches.
sceneBrief: 1991 April Myongji University entrance: students gathered in shock and grief near a campus wall after a fatal police crackdown; distant plainclothes police with white helmets and denim jackets. Show the aftermath, no beating or injured body.
